page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. It features 90 dedicated vCPUs derived from 45 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 720.0 GB of RAM, providing 8.0 GB of memory per core. For local storage, it includes 3216 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across 8 local SSDs. No GPU accelerators are present, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates top-tier multi-core performance, ranking in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core CPU tests, PassMark CPU scores, and software compilation via Clang. Cryptographic capabilities are also highly rated, with PassMark CPU encryption tests scoring in the top 10%, aided by hardware-accelerated instruction sets such as AES and VAES. Memory performance is strong, with read-only bandwidth for both small and large blocks placing in the top 25%, though large-block write bandwidth falls into the average category. Single-core performance is generally average to strong, with Geekbench single-core scores in the middle 50% and stress-ng single-core performance in the top 25%.

Given its high memory density and integrated high-speed NVMe storage, this instance is well-suited for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads such as large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, and data-intensive processing pipelines. PassMark database operations and Redis SET operations both perform in the top 25%, confirming its suitability for transactional and analytical database systems. Additionally, the instance shows strong performance in medium-sized LLM inference tasks, though performance drops to average for larger 70B models. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high resource density of memory and local NVMe storage relative to the vCPU count provides a consolidated platform for workloads that would otherwise require multi-node clustering.

It features 3216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 8 drives, with no integrated GPU. The instance delivers top-tier multi-core CPU performance, ranking in the top 10% for PassMark CPU and software compilation benchmarks, alongside strong memory read bandwidth. Single-core performance and large-block memory write speeds remain in the average to strong range. With a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high-speed local storage, this server is highly optimized for memory-intensive databases, Redis caching, and data-processing workloads.
